scope: Pinned BlastEm libretro Android ARM64 build with IS_LIB and DISABLE_NUKLEAR. The standalone SDL/JNI UI, Android application, Nuklear UI, bundled images, and shaders are not linked. The selected core includes BlastEm and its vendored zlib implementation.
conclusion: Compatible candidate. BlastEm is GPL-3.0-or-later and the only selected third-party implementation is zlib under the Zlib license.
remainingReleaseGates: physical menu-driven one-window lifecycle and performance qualification
